output.notes: All 8 sizes of the standard Pythia suite (the deduplicated suite uses identical architectures). Primary config is 70M. head_dim (d_model/heads, e.g. 64 for 70M), vocab size, rope theta and pairing, norm eps, GELU form and qkv bias are not stated, so they are left not_stated. Rotary fraction 0.25 is stated, but n_rot is not given as a number. d_ff and pre-norm placement are marked inherited from GPT-3 via the 'largely follow' sentence; they are not restated in this paper. The paper states the parallel attention+FFN (GPT-J) residual. Whether it uses one shared layernorm or two separate ones is not stated; two are drawn. The final layernorm in the head is assumed from the GPT-3 lineage and is not stated here. Flash Attention is an implementation detail only.
